title: SandboxUpsert
description: `PUT /host/v1/projects/:id` — idempotent create-or-update of a sandbox record. The API holds these secrets encrypted in Postgres and hands them to the host here; the host is the only process that has them at runtime.

engine_secret.description: Bearer the host must present to this project's engine control plane.

vault_key.description: Base64 per-project key the engine uses to encrypt vault values at rest.

Capabilities.description: Per-project capabilities, toggled by the owner through the API.

http.description: Public ingress at `/p/<project_id>/*` is served only when this is true.
